ipos.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
ipos.about: Founded in April 1992, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL) is India’s largest coal producer, mining and producing non-coking coal. The firm operates in two coal-producing areas in Odisha: Talcher and Ib Valley, and produces various grades of coal, such as washed and beneficiated coal. Its products cater to a wide range of industries, including cement, sponge iron, steel, aluminium, and paper. Mahanadi Coalfields is a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited and was started to increase the production of coal in India. It operates 17 mines, including 14 opencast mines and three underground mines. The firm uses a highly mechanised mining model where it uses surface miners for coal extraction, avoiding the use of explosives, ground vibration, dust, and noise. Furthermore, the company operates a coal washing facility that can wash up to 10 million tonnes of coal annually.
